**Findings**

- **OWID:** [Life expectancy](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/life-expectancy) hover produced a `1900` tooltip with series values. Switching Line → Table changed the URL to `?tab=table&time=latest` and displayed the table. Moving the end-year slider with three ArrowLeft presses changed `2023` to `2020`: [result](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/life-expectancy?time=earliest..2020). Tab reached chart/time controls, though four unlabeled SVG elements appeared first. At 390px, there was no horizontal overflow; the cookie banner obscured lower content and was not touched. Map, Bar, play, download, share, and fullscreen were untested.

- **Pudding:** Homepage [pudding.cool](https://pudding.cool/) first listed [The Real Kevin Bacon](https://pudding.cool/2026/10/kevin-bacon/). Wheel scrolling did not advance it: the page stayed one viewport tall with `scrollY=0`. Its exposed Next step control was used twice; the network changed to a starfield and the statement “However, Kevin Bacon is not the center of Hollywood...” appeared and remained. Mobile, arrow keys, later steps, search, and quiz controls were untested.

- **Reuters:** The first accessible item from [Reuters Graphics](https://www.reuters.com/graphics/) opened at [Welcome to the new ‘Made in China’](https://www.reuters.com/graphics/CHINA-ECONOMY/TRADE-OBJECTS/moparrmewva/). Scrolling moved normally: `0 → 800` showed prose, then `800 → 1600` showed the “Artificial Intelligence” section and its chart. The hero graphic did not stick; only the cardboard-texture background remained fixed. Mobile, keyboard, Replay, hover, and later sections were untested.

- **Observable:** [Plot Gallery](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-gallery) first linked to [Plot: Scatterplot](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-scatterplot/2). Its embedded 640×400 SVG scatterplot rendered successfully. No exposed input, select, or slider was present, so no input interaction was available to test. Interactive tips, hover, mobile, and other examples were untested.

No login, consent choice, form submission, purchase, upload, message, or settings change was performed.
